name: Fly
kurzbeschreibung: Relaxed bar in the centre of Wörgl on Bahnhofstraße, open daily from 12:00 to 02:00.
beschreibung: The Bar Fly is located at Bahnhofstraße 51 in the centre of Wörgl, a town in the district of Kufstein in Tirol. With its relaxed atmosphere in the heart of the town, the bar invites you to linger. It welcomes its guests daily from 12:00 noon to 02:00 at night. The team at Bar Fly warmly welcomes visitors and looks forward to their visit. Anyone wishing to spend a casual evening in sociable company will find a laid-back spot in the town centre. The central location on Bahnhofstraße makes the bar easy to reach. Whether as a start to the evening or as a late finish – Bar Fly is a relaxed address for all who appreciate Wörgl town centre.
